provenance: Presentation adjustments for delayed swing entry and smooth transitions. Camera: measured from recordings of the real game (ArkWeb swingrec, 2026-10-03): 5.4-5.7 m behind and 2-3 m above him, horizontal FOV from 93 degrees slow to 111 at speed (between HeroSwingCameraConfig's FOVBoostSpeedMin/Max, 10 and 33 m/s, at its FOVBlendUpSpeed); the yaw closes in on his heading a second after the last look input (ArkWeb's swing camera follow). The game's own swing camera code is not ported. Looking up (authored): the view can tilt up to 72 degrees; the boom comes in toward 2.5 m and keeps 0.35 m over the floor under it, and once it is down there the view alone tilts on up, so he can look up at the rooftops from the street.
